title: RMC Server Mod
description: Mod for the RMC Server, adds weapons and a semi-permadeath system
body:
**(Heavily inspired by CSMP and Minecraft Dungeons)

## Current additions:
- Broadsword, a high damage, low swing speed sword spawning in structures spanning most forest biomes. Has a custom enchant "Siphoning," which has a small chance to heal the user 1 health (0.5 Hearts) when hitting an enemy.
- Boneclub, a very high damage, very low swing speed sword (in functionality) craftable earlygame primarily from bone blocks. Has a custom enchant "Stun," which gives slowness for a short time when hitting an opponent.
- Dagger, a medium damage, high swing speed sword craftable from sea crystals and quartz. Has a custom enchant "Static," which makes the dagger deal no knockback and cancel any momentum of opponents in the air.
- Undern Elegy, a powerful high damage, medium swing speed sword spawning in altars only found in dark oak forests and pale gardens. Only one sword can exist at a time per world, and if the weapon is destroyed, you can interact with the altar again to get another. When used with a Suspicious Poppet in the offhand, any player killed with this sword will be "Banished" to the new Death Dimension, functioning as a ban until that player can be revived.
- Totem Items: These include the Suspicious Poppet and Revival Totem. They both have similar crafting recipies, both needing a nether star, conduit, and 2 new items, being the heart of sculk (very rare drop from wardens) and the elder guardian spike (uncommon drop from elder guardians, also craftable into a trident). Using the revival totem in the overworld allows the player to enter another currently "banished" (and online) players name and bring them back.
- Death Dimension, a low visibility limbo-like world which spawns skeletons and is covered in black sand and oak trees. It functions essentially as an empty overworld, where food is scarce and progression is tough, but possible. Shrines spawn around this dimension containing very valuable loot such as gold, copper, iron, diamonds, and books. Mineshafts are the only vanilla structure which spawns here, giving access to what little food and crops can be found in it's chests. New recipies allow black sand to be turned into dirt, normal sand, and cobblestone. Black sand also has a rare chance to drop flint or iron nuggets instead, giving access to different materials and possibilities. A new ore, Tenebrite, spawns here, which is a diamond alternative which can be made into tools with special effects but lower durability. Tenebrite can also be used as a powerful fuel source.
- Yellow Gold Tools, an upgrade to golden tools which have durability similar to iron and higher mining speed. Gold, iron, and copper are used to make yellow gold alloy, which is then used to make the tools.
- Other: Creative mode exclusive weapons with the same properties as the Undern Elegy (Can "Banish"), A Wimpy Toy :)

### Compatibility

All weapons have been made (somewhat) compatible with the [Backslot Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/backslot-mod) by medecoole

All enchantments have descriptions (Designed to be compatible with [Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement) by MoriyaShiine)
